quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 (April-September 2025) consolidated results: revenue JPY 1,572,363 million (+3.8% YoY), growing mainly in Bio CDMO, semiconductor materials, business solutions and imaging; operating income JPY 158,486 million (+16.9%); income before income taxes JPY 161,914 million (+15.3%); net income attributable to shareholders JPY 120,232 million (+9.0%). Segments: Healthcare revenue JPY 499,185 million (+3.1%), operating income JPY 23,681 million (+2.8%); Electronics JPY 209,466 million (+1.9%), JPY 41,972 million (+8.2%); Business Innovation JPY 572,187 million (+0.8%), JPY 31,364 million (+24.1%); Imaging JPY 291,525 million (+13.3%), JPY 80,392 million (+21.5%), helped by higher instax film supply from expanded production capacity. H1 R&D JPY 77,305 million (-4.1%).
quarterly_data.figure: H1 revenue JPY 1,572,363 million (+3.8%); operating income JPY 158,486 million (+16.9%); Electronics revenue JPY 209,466 million (+1.9%), operating income JPY 41,972 million (+8.2%)

quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 semiconductor materials: sales grew, led by copper-wiring CMP slurry (which the company describes as world's top share) mainly for advanced semiconductors for generative AI; customer inquiries for polyimide rose as the advanced-packaging market expands. In July 2025 the company announced a negative-tone ArF immersion resist that uses no PFAS, and in September 2025 it started selling a new CMP slurry that evolves its front-end copper-wiring CMP slurry for advanced packaging; the product is used in hybrid bonding and has been adopted by a major semiconductor device maker. The AF materials business declined overall as sales of anti-reflection materials for OLED and data tape fell, despite adoption of new display materials.

The company changed its FY2026 (year ending March 2026) Healthcare segment capex plan to JPY 364,000 million (capacity expansion, rationalization and automation, environment), changing the Bio CDMO capex plan amount because of higher labor and material costs, among other factors.
